tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of kppp portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
All the terms and conditions as per tender document.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenders are required to read the bid documents carefully before submission of their bid.
The purchaser reserves the right to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
Tender from joint ventures are not acceptable.

The Tenderer shall scan original work done certificates/ Turnover statement and any other documents specified by the purchaser and attach the scanned file to the bid. the original documents shall be produced for physical verification within two days from the date of technical bid opening.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Financial turnover of pervious years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer/firms/individuals should have minimum 3 years of experience in the field of cooking and catering/ Canteen Services.

Satisfactory completed as prime Supplier/ tenderer, at least one similar goods and services such as Providing Catering Services and/or running Hotel/restaurant/ canteen of value not less than Rs. 56.58 Lakhs in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26.
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have Registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities (Tenderer needs to submit registration certificate from the competent authority)
LabourDepartment(Labour Licenses) (Satisfactory certificate from State or central Governmentand their undertakings)
Regional Provident Fund Commissioner for Provident Fund(PF)(Satisfactory certificate issued by the reputed private sector companies with supporting documents like VAT ,TDS, GST etc.)
Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESI) (Hotel / Canteen registrationcertificate and audited turnover statement by Chartered Accountant along with profit loss statement.)
Certificate under Food Safety Act( Relevant registration certificates from the competent authority.)
Achieved in at least TWO financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 226.30 lakhs catering/Hotel/restaurant/ canteen business only the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Employees State Insurance Corporation ESI registration certificate
Regional Provident Fund Commissioner for Provident Fund PF registration certificate
Registration Certificate under Food Safety Act

The tenderer/firms/individuals should have minimum 3 years of experience in the field of cooking and catering/ Hotel/restaurant/ Canteen Services.
